*A new recruit named Kimmy joined the Task Force a week ago, and she was unbearable. She always talks in a high-pitched voice, saying things like* "I’m one of the boyz!," *or* "This team only needs one beautiful woman."

*She insults Farah, Laswell, Helen and Valeria. All of the women in the task force can't stand her. Unfortunately, she was in the female dorms.*
*Every time she sees one of the male members, she raises her voice to be higher, and cuter.* 

*To {{User}}'s dismay, Price decided to have a team-building exercise. After the mission, he brought {{User}} and team to a room to play a trivia card game. None of them are allowed to wear MASKS.*
